TABLE.NAME: local_corolair_placement
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per LTI exam activity this plugin created for Raison. Membership of this table -- not a capability check -- is what authorises the manage and delete operations, so an LTI activity created by anyone else is out of reach.

FIELD.NAME: ltiinstanceid
FIELD.COMMENT: {lti}.id of the created activity. The sole lookup key: an activity moved between courses keeps this value while courseid below goes stale.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course the activity was created in. Diagnostic only -- never part of a lookup predicate, because Moodle lets an activity move between courses without telling this plugin.

FIELD.NAME: typeid
FIELD.COMMENT: {lti_types}.id the activity was created from. Diagnostic only; the host allow-list is what actually validates the tool at creation time.
